_note: English texts. Keys must match et.json exactly; the build fails otherwise.

meta.description: Christmas and winter gifts, delivered to parcel machines across Estonia.

christmas.beforeCutoff: Last day to order for delivery before Christmas: {date}
christmas.afterCutoff: The Christmas order deadline has passed. New orders arrive after Christmas.

home.intro: Decorations, gifts and things for a winter home. Delivered to the parcel machine you choose, anywhere in Estonia.
home.empty: No products have been added yet.

facts.title: To parcel machines across Estonia
facts.body: Choose the Omniva, DPD or Smartpost parcel machine that suits you in the cart.

facts.title: 14-day right of withdrawal
facts.body: If a product does not suit you, you can withdraw from the order within 14 days.

facts.title: Secure payment
facts.body: Payment is made on Stripe's payment page. Card details never reach the shop's server.

product.christmas: Arrives before Christmas if ordered by: {date}
product.soldOutNote: This product is sold out at the moment.
product.illustrativeAlt: Illustrative image, not a photo of the product
product.illustrativeNote: The picture is illustrative and does not show the exact product on sale. A product photo will be added before sales begin.

footer.returns: You can withdraw from an order within 14 days of receiving the goods.
footer.tagline: Christmas decorations, gifts and things for a winter home, to parcel machines across Estonia.

category.empty: There are no products in this category right now.

cart.title: Cart
cart.unavailableLine: This product is no longer available and was removed from your cart.
cart.parcelMachineHint: For example: Tartu Lõunakeskus parcel machine
cart.contactNote: Your e-mail address and phone number are asked for in the next step, on the payment page.
cart.legalNote: By confirming the order you accept the terms of sale and take on an obligation to pay. You have the right to withdraw from the order within 14 days.
cart.paying: Taking you to the payment page…

errors.form: Please fill in the recipient's name and the parcel machine.
errors.payments-not-configured: Payment is not open yet. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: A product in your cart is not on sale right now.
errors.generic: The order could not be placed. Please try again.

order.paidTitle: Thank you, your order is confirmed
order.paidBody: We have received your payment. An order confirmation is on its way to your e-mail address.
order.unpaidBody: If you have just finished paying, confirmation can take a few minutes. Your cart is still there.
order.errorTitle: The order status could not be checked
order.errorBody: If the money has left your account, your order has reached us. If in doubt, please contact us.

legal.draftNotice: Draft. This text has not been approved by the shop owner and is not in force.

email.subject: Your order from {shop}
email.body: Thank you for your order. We have received your payment and are starting to fulfil it.

preview.notice: Preview: the shop is not open yet. Products marked as drafts cannot be bought, and their prices and texts may change.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong or the page has been removed.
